name: college-bus-tracking-monorepo
description: College Bus Live Tracking and Transport Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:exe: npm run export:web --workspace=apps/mobile && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path apps/mobile/electron/dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/mobile/electron/dist }; Copy-Item -Recurse apps/mobile/dist apps/mobile/electron/dist" && npx -y electron-packager ./apps/mobile/electron "Bus Track" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist-mobile-exe --electron-version=44.4.5 --overwrite
scripts.build:admin-exe: npm run build --workspace=apps/admin-web && npx -y electron-packager ./apps/admin-web "Bus Track Admin" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist-exe --overwrite --prune=true

author: College Transport System Team
